## Main failure in this run

**The remaining blocker is the 1H execution layer, not weekly bias.**
The corrected raw output now reads:

- `BTC 1H: local file data/hyperliquid_snapshots/BTC_1h.parquet did not cover 2024-07-01 → 2025-03-31 and remote gap-fill returned nothing`
- `ETH 1H: local file data/hyperliquid_snapshots/ETH_1h.parquet did not cover 2024-07-01 → 2025-03-31 and remote gap-fill returned nothing`

That is the correct interpretation of the local data inventory:

- 4H history exists from 2023-12-26 onward.
- 1H history exists only from 2025-09-10 onward.
- Therefore the period can be analyzed top-down only through 4H, not through
  the final 1H trigger contract required by AGENTS.md.

## What changed and why

**No theory change in this iteration.** The rerun improved execution
infrastructure understanding, not theory quality. There is still no valid
trade-level sample to refine because the mandatory 1H trigger layer is absent.

## 4H/1H execution notes

- The 4H side is now structurally available for this period; the missing piece
  is strictly the 1H trigger series.
- This is exactly why the final theory insists every entry rule specify both
  the 4H trigger and the 1H entry signal: without the lower layer, the period
  cannot be honestly scored end-to-end.
